category: Liberation sequence / contextual gzhi compounds / nakedly

treatment: Preserve every liberation mode, negation and repetition. Propose basis of dependence and nothing to repeat for the two complete constructions, not as replacements for standalone gzhi. Render nakedly provisionally while retaining the original spelling in the source record.
uncertainty: The contextual compounds and cer construction require review with the preceding liberation account.
action: Approve these construction-level uses only after checking U03243–U03258 as one reply.

category: Compassionate responsiveness / three primordial knowings / abbreviated fivefold names
problem: The passage negates the absence of compassionate responsiveness and speaks of stains of what is pure from the outset. 'chang gzhi is a support construction. The fivefold primordial-knowing names are abbreviated; so sor rtogs differs from the spelling in the established full discriminating-primordial-knowing entry. ji ltar and ji snyed are not fully expanded here.
treatment: Preserve the double negative, the purity/stain statement, and all three embodiment scopes. Keep support for holding provisional. Recognize the fivefold list through separate terminology proposals, using the established discriminating entry locally without changing the source spelling. Distinguish knowing how things are and knowing the multiplicity, bracketing supplied objects.
uncertainty: The holding-support clause, the abbreviated fivefold predicates and the scope of the two ways of knowing remain provisional.
action: Review the full account and approve the short forms through the explicit continuation at U03306–U03315, not by silently importing a generic wisdom list.

category: Ground/path/body sequence / vase embodiment / channel and lamp relations

The relation of the named channels, five primordial knowings and moving/nonmoving spheres is condensed. Knowing how things are is linked to two lamps, as is knowing the multiplicity.
treatment: Preserve Ground/path/body order, propose vase embodiment without adding youthful, and retain the exact canonical Kati name. Preserve both two-lamp groupings rather than turn sphere-and-basic-space into one lamp. Keep the channels/spheres sentence provisional and the eye passage nonanatomical beyond its wording.
uncertainty: The conjunctions in U03304–U03309, the body-time construction and the two kinds of knowing require review.
action: Approve the vase and fivefold-name proposals and check the full channel-to-lamp syntax against the original.

category: Two manners of abiding / unpartitioned embodiments / bab and leaving constructions
problem: The source denies division of essence into three embodiments, then describes colored light without delineated characteristics. bab las grub and shes bya'i bab are compressed. rang bzhag and cog bzhag occur together with sealing through self-liberation.
treatment: Preserve the two abidings, three aspects, three embodiments and five colors in source order. Keep accomplished from its own condition provisional rather than add an effortlessness claim. Distinguish leaving of itself from leaving just as it is, retaining self-liberation as the established term.
uncertainty: The two bab constructions and the final leaving/sealing syntax remain open.
action: Review the connected account of essence, intrinsic nature and compassionate responsiveness without replacing its predicates with a standard exposition.

category: One and many / face-mirror simile / unresolved demonstratives

uncertainty: The U03343 referents and the attachment of moving knowing to the empty object require review.

category: All-basis versus dharma embodiment / word explanation / subdivisions
problem: The source explains kun gzhi through its components, describes four subdivisions tersely, and contrasts it with the dharma embodiment. gzhi within the all-basis word explanation differs from the primordial Ground subdivision. The final time/method/example/measure-to-result clause is condensed.
treatment: Retain the canonical all-basis and dharma embodiment, use basis only in the explicitly marked word explanation, and preserve primordial Ground as a distinct item. Keep free from conceptual elaborations for spros bral and all three embodiment subdivisions. Do not supply definitions of the four all-basis categories.
uncertainty: The subdivision identities, arbitrary-holding clause and concluding relation to the result require review.
action: Approve the component-level word explanation as a narrowly scoped contextual use and review the entire distinction against its question.

category: Ordinary mind versus primordial knowing / verbal sems / incomplete nominal sequence
problem: The source uses sems verbally in the word explanation and dran yul in a recollection-related construction, unlike the established noun sems and standalone dran pa. Primordial knowing's three subdivisions are not relisted. The final signs/measures/entry sequence is largely nominal.

Record think as a grammatical verb use within the explicit etymological sequence, and what is recalled as a complete construction, not a global replacement of mindfulness. Preserve the threefold count and nominal concluding list without inventing missing subdivisions.
uncertainty: The exact four-question grammar, the recalled-object relation and the final nominal attachments remain provisional.
action: Review the complete definitions and approve the local grammatical uses separately from the canonical noun entries.

category: Refined/turbid elements / awakening ordinary mind / particle terms / source claims
problem: The source combines bodily effects, lamps, practices and particle designations. don dam byang sems extends the earlier unresolved short expression into a new context. treatment: Preserve all four elements, their separate effects and lamp relations. Record the new contextual use of awakening ordinary mind as provisional, retain the particle names without adding an unstated measurement system, and keep differentiating conceptualization distinct from ordinary mind. The bodily and aging claims remain claims of the translated source.
uncertainty: The byang sems sense, particle designations, the wind-refined-part construction and final time/method syntax remain unresolved. No medical or nutritional efficacy is established.
action: Review the technical terms against authorized evidence; do not treat this draft as a treatment or nourishment protocol.

category: Packing the lamp / unspecified supports / three appearances / editorial safety
problem: The source names three supports without listing them and mentions thumb and forefinger without a complete procedure. It first names the direct-perception vision, then experience and two further appearance phrases, finally saying three appearances. These are not textually identical to the established four-vision list.
treatment: Retain the unspecified three, the body-part reference and the canonical direct-perception vision. Preserve the subsequent appearance names and the written threefold total without forcing a four-vision mapping. Distinguish the editorial warning against inferred eye pressure from the source's words.
uncertainty: The supports, physical application and exact grouping of the three appearances require review. This is not a safe, complete or authorized practical instruction.
action: Obtain source-based clarification of the procedure and categories; do not infer or perform pressure on the eyes or related manipulations from this draft.

Render father/mother as source designations, not an added account of sexual activity. Do not calculate attainment times from the unspecified diligence scale.
uncertainty: The fingerbreadth reading, the two/three portions, patch geometry and relation of unchanging to individual times remain provisional.
action: Review the full size and maturation sequence against the print, retaining its symbolic descriptions without a reconstructed optical procedure.
